statement: The proportion of SUID cases with medical complications during pregnancy differs based on maternal prepregnancy BMI levels within the case series.
rationale: This study will examine how medical complications during pregnancy vary across subgroups defined by maternal prepregnancy body mass index (BMI) levels within the case series. The design is a case-only analysis, focusing on associations among cases without population-level comparisons.
prior_art: suid_literature_abstracts.C10 suggests that maternal obesity increases SUID risk but does not compare medical complications during pregnancy to prepregnancy BMI in SUID cases specifically; bedsharing_ms_v7.C9 shows incidence patterns over time but does not address the relationship between BMI and medical complications.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish incidence rates or causal relationships; it can only show associations among cases based on recorded medical complications and prepregnancy BMI levels within the ncfrp_v51 dataset.
